method: read-only semantic census of the pinned source; behaviour described in ECDEV's words, no donor code copied
dependencies: camel-oasis==0.2.5, camel-ai==0.2.78, zep-cloud==3.25.0, openai>=1.0 (OASIS internals not verified: not installed)
boundary: Every ECDEV use of these ideas is SIMULATED: SIMULATED != OBSERVED != DEMAND != SALES FORECAST

concepts.finding: two status machines (created/preparing/ready/running/stopping/stopped/completed/failed; runner idle..failed), monitor polls action logs every 2 s, per-simulation finalisation lock; 'paused' declared but unreachable
concepts.commerce: explicit per-scenario-run state machine with a single finalisation path

concepts.finding: LLM writes hot topics and initial posts; posts mapped to agents by entity type then alias then influence; injected as forced round-0 actions
concepts.commerce: seed shocks (launch, price cut, competitor ad) as scripted round-0 events tied to typed actors

concepts.finding: one agent per extracted knowledge-graph entity; no sampling or distribution; unseeded random fallbacks for counts and demographics
concepts.commerce: sample buyer and competitor populations from declared distributions rather than one agent per entity

concepts.finding: activity config with many fields of which only active_hours and activity_level are read at runtime (dead parameters)
concepts.commerce: typed numeric agent state (budget, price sensitivity, loyalty) with a harness proving every field is consumed

concepts.finding: per-platform SQLite inside OASIS, deleted at run start
concepts.commerce: one authoritative per-run market store rebuilt fresh

concepts.finding: rounds = hours*60/minutes_per_round (default 72); per round an activation set chosen by unseeded random sampling with hour multipliers; concurrent LLM steps (semaphore 30); order nondeterministic
concepts.commerce: discrete-time loop with explicit activation sets and an atomic market step logged per tick

concepts.finding: closed platform action sets (6 Twitter, 13 Reddit); LLM chooses via tool calls over a recommender feed
concepts.commerce: closed commerce action set (buy, wait, switch, review, return) with every choice validated
deterministic market-clearing function over chosen actions

concepts.finding: fixed round count or signal; no convergence test
concepts.commerce: fixed horizon or convergence criterion, recording which rule fired

concepts.finding: two platforms concurrently in one process; no Monte-Carlo replicates
concepts.commerce: N independent seeded replicates per scenario

concepts.concept: seeds, replication, dispersion, sensitivity, scenario comparison
concepts.finding: no seeds, single run per id, no variance, no sweeps, no baseline pairing
concepts.commerce: the gaps define ECDEV's own requirements
per-tick SIMULATED aggregates (units, share) with dispersion

concepts.finding: LLM-written personas from graph search context; retries with decreasing temperature; random fallbacks
concepts.commerce: segment personas frozen as versioned, hashed artifacts

concepts.finding: no initial follow graph; recommender weights hard-coded but never passed to OASIS; diffusion only emergent
concepts.commerce: explicit referral graph and injected recommender parameters; cascade metrics against a Bass baseline

concepts.finding: filesystem command queue; interview injects a manual action and reads the answer from the trace
concepts.commerce: post-run survey probes recorded as SIMULATED stated preference

concepts.finding: LLM proposes horizon, cadence and per-agent parameters; some multipliers never applied
concepts.commerce: LLM may propose parameters; a validator records proposed vs defaulted vs clamped

concepts.finding: simulated hour is only an activation label; logs use wall clock
concepts.commerce: explicit simulated calendar separated from wall clock in every record

concepts.finding: simulated actions are written into the same knowledge graph as document-derived knowledge without a content label (metadata only) - an anti-reference
concepts.commerce: separate SIMULATED, OBSERVED and DEMAND stores with a provenance firewall
per-run call/token/cost ledger with a hard cap

research_questions.q: replicate variance and the replicate count needed for a stable interval
seed sub-streams (activation, persona sampling, shocks) for bit-reproducible LLM-free runs
capped random activation versus Poisson-rate activation against observed purchase-time histograms
effect of persona text versus numeric segment parameters on simulated choices
provenance firewall blocking simulated writes into observed or demand stores, with leakage tests
recommender-weight sensitivity of simulated sales concentration
initial referral-graph sensitivity of cascade size
common random numbers for baseline versus promotion lift
LLM-proposed versus rule-default configuration effect on outcomes
LLM call and token scaling with agents x rounds x activation

no_research_value: Flask API routes and polling endpoints
Zep batch/ontology/retry plumbing and memory-updater queues
Windows and logging patches, i18n, JSON-repair helpers
reference_only: time-of-day multipliers and entity archetypes (no empirical grounding)
memory write-back design as an anti-reference
